responsibility: Implements dot-operator method probing for Rust HIR expressions. Using the autoderef framework, it searches inherent impl methods, trait impl methods, trait item defaults, and methods made available by explicit type bounds, compares candidate self types against progressively adjusted receivers, and returns MethodCandidate sets annotated with the receiver adjustment sequence needed to call the selected method.
same_name_distinction: Implements receiver-method lookup for the dot operator by running autoderef search and testing inherent impl, trait impl, trait item, and predicate-bound candidates against the adjusted receiver. Unlike rust-hir-dot-operator.h, it contains the candidate collection and selection logic, not just the MethodCandidate/MethodResolver declarations.
